Nora CSM: quick post-smoke notes for OrchidWay private/VPC onboarding. Ran into three small items: NAT/SNAT, KMS grant, and control-plane log filter.
Ethan Eng: what did the smoke runner show?
Nora CSM: outbound tokens intermittently 403 until SNAT was applied; also one KMS Encrypt failed during parallel uploads; CP logs missing some api calls in Splunk.
Marco (OrchidWay): SNAT rule added for 10.50.0.0/16 -> works for egress now.
Priya Sec: KMS error shows AccessDenied on Encrypt for role arn:aws:iam::777666555444:role/orchid-ingest. Need key policy or Grant. Example snippet: `{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::777666555444:role/orchid-ingest"},"Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],"Resource":"*"}`
Marco (OrchidWay): Grant applied, re-tested -> Encrypt ok.
Lina CE: control-plane filter used `redwood.aws` in pattern; some events use `api.redwood`. Updated subscription with both. CLI used: `aws logs put-subscription-filter --log-group-name /redwood/orchidway/controlplane --filter-pattern '{($.eventSource = "redwood.amazonaws.com") || ($.eventSource = "api.redwood")}' --destination-arn arn:aws:logs:us-east-1:123456789012:destination:splunk-orchid'`
Nora CSM: Action items: 1) Marco -> confirm SNAT test matrix and share tcpdump. 2) Marco -> confirm KMS policy persisted (not just grant). 3) Lina -> monitor CP logs for 24h.
Marco (OrchidWay): will share tcpdump and policy change by EOD.
Nora CSM: Renewals note: minor delay ~1 day, marking as low-medium risk. Also feedback: docs lacking an example mapping for `redwood.request_id -> splunk.request_id` and timestamp parsing. Lina, can you add a short example to the runbook?
Lina CE: yep, adding a mapping + grok sample now.
deploy-bot: Deployment 6612345678 completed for orchidway-priv (green) :white_check_mark: 
Nora CSM: closing once tcpdump + policy confirmed. Thanks all.
